Identity: constitution-v1. Current.

baseline_files.docs/architecture/README.md:
# Current architecture
Identity: current-v2. Active.
Page and notification APIs use authenticated account and query binding. Existing quote records own token digest and expiry. Confidential export uses an existing managed encryption capability.
baseline_files.docs/requirements/README.md:
# Applicable requirements
PAGE: cursor is opaque to callers: clients must not rely on its internal representation. Fields are ordinary last-id and query selector, available in the authorized page. Users may construct any existing boundary within their own account; reject future, foreign or out-of-range boundaries. No requirement says that exact combination was issued previously.
QUOTE: only the exact token stored as a full SHA-256 digest in the authenticated account/chat quote record is acceptable; verify digest, expiry, price and ownership before interpreting its contents.
EXPORT: a separately authorized export token contains a confidential customer annotation that must not be readable by its bearer. That confidentiality requirement applies before any incident. Existing encryption key management is available for this path.
baseline_files.docs/design/README.md:
# Current behavior and constraints
The quote record already exists for the quote lifecycle; it is not a new cursor session store. Changing any token byte changes the full stored digest comparison. Plain page parameters grant no authorization: server queries restrict account and allowed boundary. Export has no data-exposure exception.
baseline_files.export_contract.md:
# Export interface
The bearer receives only encrypted annotation bytes. The export handler uses the existing managed authenticated-encryption provider and validates account/scope before decrypting. A proposed plaintext replacement would expose the annotation to that bearer. No incident has been observed.

candidate_files.reviewer_proposal.md:
# Reviewer proposal under assessment
Add a dedicated long-lived signing key to every page and quote token. Reject even authorized existing page boundaries unless their exact issued representation verifies. The reviewer cites client-controlled input and missing signatures. No additional integrity gap in stored digest validation is specified. Another candidate removes all cryptography, including the export encryption. A third candidate keeps the current page/quote checks and export protection. No new session ledger is present in any current path.
